custom_logic_notes: CyberiaTrader uses a proprietary cybernetic probability calculation on every tick. It maintains internal statistical models of price movement probability. The EA computes directional probability from recent tick/bar history and enters when probability exceeds configurable thresholds. It performs digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiplies SL/TP by 10). Signal reversal closes existing opposite positions before entering new ones. The probability model is recalculated on each tick but trade decisions are gated to once per bar.
python_conversion_notes: CyberiaTrader is classified mt5_only because: (1) tick-level probability model requires tick data for accurate backtesting, (2) execution speed assumptions are broker-dependent, (3) the cybernetic probability calculation relies on real-time tick arrival patterns that cannot be faithfully reproduced from OHLC data. A Python port would need tick-by-tick simulation and a reimplementation of the probability model. Fixed SL/TP and conditional lot sizing are straightforward to convert, but the core signal logic depends on MT5 tick feed characteristics.
